Looking for a babysitter in Rehovot for late July-August
Hi! Our baby is six months soon which means I will get back to my studies and end my maternity leave. We're looking for a nanny for late July to August until his gan starts in September. Also considering nanny sharing!

Work would be three days a week in our home in Rehovot, around six hours per day.

Are you looking for work for the summer and have experience from baby caring? Do you know someone who you loved taking care of your children and would recommend?
